Employment Opportunities
September 30, 2026
Keweenaw County Clerk & Register of Deeds Vacancy
Applications are being accepted for appointment to fill a midterm vacancy in the position of Keweenaw County Clerk & Register of Deeds. Under Michigan law, the combined office of County Clerk and Register of Deeds fulfills distinct constitutional and statutory functions, and applicants must meet the necessary criteria as established under Michigan law. Applications are available in the link below. Applications for this position will be accepted until Friday, October 9, 2026 at 4:00 p.m.
The annual salary for this position is $73,460 and includes a comprehensive benefit package, including health insurance, life insurance, and participation in the MERS pension retirement program.
Completed applications may be mailed to:
Circuit Judge Brittany A. Bulleit
Houghton County Courthouse
401 E. Houghton Avenue
Houghton, MI 49931
or may be emailed to:
clerk@keweenawcountymi.gov
